parts.label: Part 1
parts.article:
Part one. You will hear a woman phoning a travel agent to inquire about holiday apartments in Greece. First, you have some time to look at questions one to five.

Now, listen carefully and answer questions one to five.

Greek Island Holidays. Can I help you?

Yes. I hope so. I have a friend who's just come back from Corfu, and she's recommended some apartments in Arillas. She thought they might be on your list.

Arillas, Arillas. Let me see. Uh, can you give me the names?

Yes. The first, Rose Garden Apartments. I'd like to go with another friend in the last week of October.

Well, we've got a lovely studio flat available at that time. I'm sure you'd enjoy the entertainment program there too, with Greek dancing in the restaurant.

And the cost for each of us?

Two hundred and nineteen pounds.

That sounds very reasonable. I'm just jotting down some notes. Now, the second one she mentioned was called Blue Bay.

Blue Bay.

Yes. In fact, that's very popular, and it has some special features.

Really?

The main attraction is the large swimming pool with salt water.

Hmm. Much healthier, I understand.

That's right. And it isn't far from the beach either, only three hundred meters. And only around half a kilometer to some shops, so you don't have to be too energetic.

Is it much more expensive than the first one?

Let me just check.

I think at the time you want to go, it's around two hundred and sixty pounds. Uh, no, two hundred and seventy-five pounds to be exact.

Right. I've got that. Now, there are just two more apartments to ask you about. Um, I can't read my own writing. Something to do with sun, sunshine, is it?

I think you meant the Sunshade Apartments. They're on a mountainside.

Any special features?

Yes. Each room has its own sun terrace, and there are shared barbecue facilities.

Ooh, sounds lovely.

Yes, it is rather well-equipped. It also provides water sports. It has its own beach. There are facilities for water-skiing.

Any kitesurfing? My friend's quite keen.

Not at the hotel, but I'm sure you'll find some in Arillas. There's also satellite TV in the apartments.

And how much is that one?

Four hundred and ninety pounds with two sharing.

You mean two hundred and forty-five pounds each?

I'm afraid not. Each person has to pay that amount, and there must be at least two in an apartment.

Ooh, I don't think that would be within our budget, unfortunately. And the last one sounds a bit expensive too, The Grand?

Actually, it's quite reasonable. It's an older style house with Greek paintings in every room and a balcony outside.

Sounds nice. What are the views like?

Well, there are forests all around, and they hide a supermarket just down the road, so that's very useful for all your shopping needs. Uh, there's a disco in the area too.

And the price?

Three hundred and nineteen pounds at that time. But if you leave it till November, it goes down by forty percent.

Hmm. Too late, I'm afraid.

Well, why don't I send you a brochure with full details, Miss?

Nash. But don't worry about that. I'm coming to Upminster soon, and I'll call and get one. I just wanted to get an idea first.

Well, that's fine. Uh, we've got plenty here when you come.

Before you hear the rest of the conversation, you have some time to look at questions six to ten.

Now listen and answer questions six to ten.

If you've got a minute, could I just check a couple of points about insurance? I got one policy through the post, but I'd like to see if yours is better.

Fine. Uh, what would you like to know?

Well, the one I've got has benefits, and then the maximum amount you can claim. Is that like yours?

Yes. That's how most of them are.

Well, the first thing is cancellation. If the holiday's canceled on the policy I've got, you can claim eight thousand pounds.

We can improve on that, Miss Nash. Uh, for Greek Island holidays, our maximum is ten thousand pounds.

That's good. Of course, our holiday won't even cost one thousand pounds together. [laughs]

It's still sensible to have good cover. Now, if you go to hospital, we allow six hundred pounds.

Yes, mine's similar.

And we also allow a relative to travel to your holiday resort.

My policy just says their representative will help you.

You can see there's another difference there. And what happens if you don't get on the plane?

Uh, nothing, as far as I can see on this form

Don't you have, uh, missed departure?

No, I'll just jot that down.

We pay up to a thousand pounds for that, depending on the reason, and we're particularly generous about loss of personal belongings, up to three thousand pounds, but not more than five hundred pounds for a single item.

Then I'd better not take my laptop.

Not unless you insure it separately.

Okay. Thanks very much for your time. You've really been helpful. Can I get back to you? Your name is?

Ben Ludlow. That's L-U-D-L-O-W. I'm the assistant manager here. I'll give you my number. It's oh eight one two six oh five four three two one six.

But didn't I phone oh eight one two six oh five six seven two nine four? That's what I've got on the paper.

That's the main switchboard. I've given you my direct line.

Right. Thank you very much for your time.

That is the end of part one. You now have one minute to check your answers to part one.

analyses.content: 录音明确提到距离海滩不远，只有“three hundred meters”。
And it isn't far from the beach either, only three hundred meters. And only around half a kilometer to some shops, so you don't have to be too energetic.
注意紧接着出现的“half a kilometer”指的是到商店的距离，不要把它和到海滩的距离搞混。
Something to do with sun, sunshine, is it? I think you meant the Sunshade Apartments.
不要把你听到的第一个词“sunshine”就当作答案，要耐心听工作人员最终确认的名字。
你首先听到自己提到了名字里有“sun”或者“sunshine”，随后工作人员纠正并给出了准确公寓名字“Sunshade Apartments”。
The Grand? Actually, it's quite reasonable. It's an older style house with Greek paintings in every room and a balcony outside.
只要跟上卷面上的“Greek paintings”这个并列的定位词，紧接着听连词“and”后面的信息就能轻松抓取答案，切忌走神。
在介绍The Grand公寓时，提到每个房间都有希腊画作（Greek paintings），并且外面有一个“balcony”（阳台）。
What are the views like? Well, there are forests all around, and they hide a supermarket just down the road, so that's very useful for all your shopping needs.
听到“supermarket”时要区分，它是被森林藏起来在路边的（hide a supermarket），不是用来俯瞰的自然景色。
提问景色（views）如何时，工作人员回答四周都是“forests”，对应了题干中的“overlooking”（俯瞰）。
And the price? Three hundred and nineteen pounds at that time. But if you leave it till November, it goes down by forty percent.
后面提到的“forty percent”（40%）是如果你11月份去才有的折扣，不要把这个折扣干扰项当成最终的费用填进去。
问及价格时，录音清晰回答了你想要去的那个时间段对应的价格是“Three hundred and nineteen pounds”。

analyses.content: 工作人员明确表示，针对希腊岛屿的度假项目，他们保险的最高理赔额度是“ten thousand pounds”。

Well, the first thing is cancellation. If the holiday's canceled on the policy I've got, you can claim eight thousand pounds. We can improve on that, Miss Nash. Uh, for Greek Island holidays, our maximum is ten thousand pounds.
原有的保险理赔额是“eight thousand pounds”，这是你自己说的条件，千万别把客人自己现有的额度当作题目中对应机构的额度。
Now, if you go to hospital, we allow six hundred pounds. Yes, mine's similar. And we also allow a relative to travel to your holiday resort.
这是一道非常顺畅的推导题，跟住600磅后立刻抓取后面的名词，不要把听到的动词（如travel）错填进去。
在听到“hospital”的600英镑定位点后，顺着往下听，录音明确说到额外允许一名“relative”（亲属）前往度假地。
And what happens if you don't get on the plane? Uh, nothing as far as I can see on this form. Don't you have, uh, missed departure?
注意录音一开始利用了同义替换（没登上飞机）来引出这个话题，随后才报出标准术语，别因为开头没听到直白的“departure”就漏掉答案。
工作人员先询问没登上飞机（don't get on the plane）怎么办，随后直接点出了专有名词“missed departure”。
And we're particularly generous about loss of personal belongings, up to three thousand pounds, but not more than five hundred pounds for a single item.
题干上的“one”对应的就是录音里的“a single”，抓住了这个显而易见的同义替换就能精准捕捉到紧跟在后面的“item”。
录音讲完个人物品最高赔付3000英镑后，补充说明单件物品（a single item）的赔付不超过500英镑。
Ben Ludlow. That's L-U-D-L-O-W.
这种送分题只要按照录音中一个字母一个字母的拼写“L-U-D-L-O-W”无脑记录下来即可，注意不要产生拼写手误。
工作人员做自我介绍时说出了自己的名字“Ben Ludlow”，并且非常贴心地顺便拼写了姓氏。
